news.text: Nico #González Has Captivated LucioTomorrow #Juve-#Milan (8:45 PM)#Spalletti is counting on the Argentine from the start. #Woltemade will begin from the bench. #Amorim must break a three-year taboo.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

DESPICABLE ME!#Kolo needs to unlock himself: and he agrees with #Spalletti.The Frenchman is still without a goal after missing major chances: "The coach asks me to be more aggressive and it's true, I need to give it my all. I am willing to do anything for him. A duo with #Woltemade? Hopefully: he is great". What a battle against #Ramos, the other striker discarded by #PSG. Serena: "Nico can become Lucio's #Dybala.[Front Page TuttoSport]

⚡️‼️ "#Juventus failed to sign #Tagliafico because #Cabal stayed, causing the transfer puzzle to collapse. Another name the club considered was #AitNouri, who was contemplating a departure, but #ManchesterCity vetoed the move, refusing to release him or sell him. Contacts were also made for #Miranda, but without finding the right conditions. On the other hand, #EmersonPalmieri was never evaluated by the club.[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🔙🧐 "Among the players that #Juventus evaluated after having lost #Kessié was #Amrabat as well. He was a low-cost name that the management took into consideration, but he had already given his word to #Ajax. The bianconeri are, nonetheless, very happy to have gone for #Sarr, after also evaluating a stopgap solution. In fact, he is viewed as a player that can have a real future at the club."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "Sedorf #Owusu is a midfielder who undoubtedly performed well in the pre-season, and it is no coincidence that he ended up on the UEFA list of #Juventus.He will certainly train frequently with the first team.However, it is difficult to understand why pre-season minutes were given to players who would later leave, like #Arthur, while ignoring the youngsters on tour with the team.At 21 years old, he is no longer just a boy and already has experience in football that matters."[@romeoagresti on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

🇦🇷🆙 "#Juventus has opened a channel of communication with Nico #González's agents, they have already discussed the possibility of a contract renewal. His potential sale had been evaluated solely to raise cash: there was never any real desire from #Spalletti to get rid of him for viewing him as unsuitable. The management told #AtléticoMadrid: either €30M on a permanent basis or he stays."[Mirko Di Natale - @PuebloJ via @juventusinsidernews]

💪 "The first contacts from #Atalanta to #Juventus for Juan #Cabal date back to late June.La Dea went as far as making two offers for the player with the latest being a loan with an option to buy that would become an obligation under very difficult milestones, valued at €9M.#Giuntoli believed he could close the deal with this offer based on #Juve's openness to sending the Colombian on loan to #Bologna.However, la Vecchia Signora opposed to it, despite #Cabal being open to going to Bergamo, and requested strictly a permanent sale of €12M.The bianconeri's firm stance against the bergamaschi was also a form of retaliation for having hijacked #Kessié at the last minute.The Juve management was lef

😬 "#Spalletti does not like #Zhegrova, his situation is connected to Nico #González and it is already compromised and finalized.From the perspective of both the club and the coach, the decisions have already been made.#Juventus has already decided to leave him out of the UEFA list and could be left out the Serie A list as well.People close to Edon say that the Kosovar took the decision to exclude him from the lists very badly.#Juve hopes that a club from Turkiye or Saudi Arabia can sign him on this mercato, they would only consider a permanent sale and those two leagues are the only ones at this moment that could meet the bianconero club's expectations."[@_Morik92_ on the YouTube channel of

📋 #Spalletti is thinking of starting Nico #González in #JuveMilan, behind #KoloMuani. On the right #Conceição, while #Boga on the left is moving torward being confirmed.[Sky Sport via @AroundJuventus]

🧱🧐 "In January, offers could arrive for #Gatti, and the player himself will also take some time to reflect. In the event of an exit, the replacement could be #Tomori, a #Juventus target for next summer, when he could be available on a free transfer. However, if the right conditions are created through the sale of the ex #Frosinone, this mercato puzzle could be triggered as soon as the winter window."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇩🇪🆙 "The first feedback #Spalletti on #Woltemade is very positive. He is completely happy and satisfied with how the player has already immersed himself in the juventino reality. He is physically fit and ready: I do not rule out a starting spot for him as early as the match against #Milan."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇩🇪👀 "#Woltemade is ready, physically he is good to go. Within #Newcastle I can tell you that some were left highly surprised that the club allowed him to leave on those terms in the final stages of the mercato. It is a straight loan and furthermore, I understand there are no preferential channels: if he does well, settles in nicely and #Juventus is happy, any potential future deal would have to be built and negotiated completely from scratch."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇸🇳🆙 "#Sarr obviously does not have 90 minutes in his legs. Before leaving #Tottenham, he had a minor physical issue: the staff will need to work diligently to ensure he can build up his match fitness as quickly as possible. He is, however, fully fit in absolute terms, he is doing well. Furthermore, he is well known by #Massara, who had already tracked him during his time at #Roma."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇦🇷🔥 "Nico #González has been described to me as a leader, a different version compared to when he went to #AtléticoMadrid. Evidently, #Simeone gave him more responsibility and allowed him to bring out the best in his character. Now, he feels he can establish himself as a bianconero. We have to take injuries into account, but he has been described to me as eager to do well, motivated and determined to be a key reference point."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👋🔚 "#Juventus is dealing with three heavy outcasts:🇽🇰 A club is being sought for #Zhegrova with the hopes resting on Saudi Arabia, where a couple of days still remain. It is not easy, but the club hopes to find him a spot, otherwise he will remain frozen out of the squad until January;🇵🇱 For #Milik, a contract termination could be a possibility, but at the moment he also needs to be moved;🇮🇹 #Rugani was thought to have mercato among #Parma, #Bologna and #Monza: a few exploratory phone calls took place, but zero concrete offers. He earns €1.5/1.8M and for the bianconeri, this is a situation they want to untangle by placing him elsewhere, but it remains a highly difficult matter."[Nicolò Schir
‼️Nico #González's contract renewal is a possibility. The parties have already spoken about it and will reconnect (without any rush) during the season.[Mirko Di Natale]
